app.title: Coop TD Giant Farm Calculator
app.subtitle: Estimate time, stamina and rewards from farming Giant Invasion

inputs.cycleHint: One cycle = (runs per entry ticket − 1) ticket runs + 1 giant run; the giant run itself counts as one ticket-progress run, so entry tickets always break even.
inputs.mutualTicketing: Mutual ticketing (swap entry tickets with teammates)
inputs.giantMarkPerGiant: Extra Giant Marks per giant run
inputs.runsPerGiantTicketHint: Every run — giant runs included — adds one progress unit; a full set earns one giant entry ticket (default 5).

results.staminaBudget: Daily stamina budget (regen + ads + default diamond buys)
results.budgetFormula: Daily budget {{total}} = regen {{regen}} (24h × 60min ÷ 1 per {{regenMin}} min) + ads {{ads}} + diamond buys {{n}} × {{each}} = {{purchases}}
results.calculationBasis: Calculation basis: every run costs a fixed {{stamina}} stamina at 1x (multipliers scale it); 1 stamina regenerates every {{regenMin}} min; ads give +{{ads}}/day; diamond purchases {{ladder}} (+{{each}} stamina each); runs are 90 waves on Hard, 100 on Hell+.

footer.disclaimer: Clear rewards seeded from meowdb.com; giant kill rewards (base gacha tickets + per-stage God Stones / Jelly / Royal Jelly + relics) from the official wiki multiplier table, range values taken as midpoints. In-game values are authoritative.
